# Pulse Global

> Pulse Global BV is a software company in Ghent, Belgium. This site (https://pulse.city) is a one-page company landing page: name, tagline ("Software that breathes"), legal details and a contact address. It has no API, documentation or product pages.

Company details, as published in the site footer:

- Legal name: Pulse Global BV (a Belgian private limited company)
- Founded by: Lukas D'Hondt
- Registered office: Edward Pynaertkaai 111, 9000 Ghent, Belgium
- Enterprise and VAT number: BE 1008.017.466 (RPR Ghent, division Ghent)
- Contact: info at pulse.city (written out to avoid scrapers; replace " at " with "@")

- [Home](https://pulse.city/): The landing page itself.
- [Source code](https://github.com/pulse-global/website): The site's public repository.
